result.note: Tested the body that cleared caste enumeration, the design of the caste question and Aadhaar provision, and the phased rollout dates of Census 2027.

questions.prompt: Census 2027 will include caste enumeration for the first time since independence. Which body cleared this decision in 2025?
questions.explain: The Cabinet Committee on Political Affairs cleared caste enumeration for Census 2027 in 2025. The move followed Opposition pressure after Bihar's state-level caste survey suggested backward communities make up two-thirds of its population.
questions.source: The decision, cleared by the Cabinet Committee on Political Affairs last year

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the Census 2027 questionnaire, as reported in August 2026:
items: It marks the first inclusion of caste in the national headcount since independence.
Question 10 uses an open-ended format for self-declaration of caste and tribe.
Respondents are required to provide their Aadhaar number.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 3 is wrong: respondents are asked to provide Aadhaar, voter ID and mobile numbers voluntarily, not compulsorily. The 40-question form also tracks digital literacy, parental details, bank account holdings and Covid-19 vaccination sites.
questions.source: Respondents are also asked to voluntarily provide their Aadhaar, voter ID, and mobile numbers.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the rollout of Census 2027:
items: Enumeration began on 17 August 2026 in Ladakh, Jammu & Kashmir and Himachal Pradesh.
The nationwide survey is scheduled for February 2027 and will use a new mobile application for digital data collection.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Both statements match the story: the first phase began on 17 August 2026 in Ladakh, Jammu & Kashmir and Himachal Pradesh, and the nationwide survey follows in February 2027. Data will be collected digitally through a new mobile application.
questions.source: The nationwide survey follows in February 2027, utilizing a new mobile application for digital data collection.
